ownership.quote: Windows 365 is a Microsoft product/service offered directly by Microsoft Corporation as part of its Windows and cloud portfolio.

stage.note: Windows 365 Cloud PC is a product line of Microsoft Corporation, a public company (NASDAQ: MSFT), not a separately funded entity.

revenue.basis: Company-wide Microsoft revenue (Windows 365 does not break out its own revenue publicly); figure is for all of Microsoft Corporation, not Windows 365 specifically.

note: Windows 365 Cloud PC is a Microsoft subsidiary product (part of the Modern Work / Windows business), not an independently funded startup. Ownership, funding stage, and total funding fields reflect that it is fully owned by Microsoft Corporation (public, NASDAQ: MSFT). No separate product-level revenue is disclosed; the revenue figure given is for all of Microsoft.
